## **One** **end-to-end** **corporate travel platform**

FCM Platform is a globally consistent, locally nuanced travel management platform. An intelligent, connected ecosystem that’s AI-powered, integration rich and endlessly flexible, with one seamless experience for all stakeholders.

Put simply? The only travel management platform you’ll ever need.

[Discover FCM Platform](https://www.fcmtravel.com/en-in/solutions/fcm-platform "Corporate travel management platform ")

![fcm-hw-in-globally-consistent](https://www.fcmtravel.com/sites/default/files/styles/medium/public/fcm-hw-in-globally-consistent.png?itok=2MJGlzxk)

### **At your service**

Wherever you are, and wherever you’re going, our teams are focused on delivering travel service excellence, managing your programme with award-winning standards.

## **Empowering business** **travel for everyone**

### How your team benefits from FCM.

- [**For Business Travellers**](https://www.fcmtravel.com/en-in#)






**We make travel feel simple. Even when it isn’t.**



  - Clear choices that match your preferences, and won’t get you in trouble.
  - 24/7 support when you need it, wherever you are.
  - Proactive suggestions to make life easy when circumstances change.
  - Time and energy saved for the work that matters.

![Flight options LHR→SIN: Singapore Airlines $1,636, British Airways $1,790, Qatar Airways $1,895.](https://www.fcmtravel.com/sites/default/files/styles/medium/public/fcm-ac-business-travellers.png?itok=HWmVrkGg)

- [**For Travel Arrangers, PAs and EAs**](https://www.fcmtravel.com/en-in#)






**Everything you need, without the workarounds.**



  - Tech that makes business travel as easy as leisure travel.
  - Relevant options served first: in policy, in budget, on preference.
  - 24/7 support from people who know your business.

![UI list showing four upcoming trips: George Smith LHR→SFO May 19 needs approval; others booked.](https://www.fcmtravel.com/sites/default/files/styles/medium/public/fcm-ac-travel-arranger.png?itok=JBU6UpO3)

- [**For Travel Managers**](https://www.fcmtravel.com/en-in#)






**Everything you need for a globally coherent programme**



  - One view of travel across countries, channels and suppliers.
  - Centralised control with local flexibility built in.
  - Real-time insight into travel spend, behaviour and compliance.
  - 24/7 support that understands local nuance.

![Dashboard with a travel spend donut chart, bar graph, checklist icons, and traveler safety alert](https://www.fcmtravel.com/sites/default/files/styles/medium/public/fcm-ac-travel-managers.png?itok=uvCmQlMG)

- [**For Procurement**](https://www.fcmtravel.com/en-in#)






**Savings. Efficiencies. Control. You’ll find it all with us.**



  - Full-suite TMC including meetings & events and professional services
  - Global partner: enabling exclusive deals and savings.
  - Data you can trust: consistent, comparable, defensible.
  - Travel choices served by relevance, not by supplier margin: we’re here to save you money, not make them margin.

![Dashboard with chat bubbles, report tile, and donut chart showing $15.7K YTD savings](https://www.fcmtravel.com/sites/default/files/styles/medium/public/fcm-ac-procurement.png?itok=FI0H-xM1)

![Flight options LHR→SIN: Singapore Airlines $1,636, British Airways $1,790, Qatar Airways $1,895.](https://www.fcmtravel.com/sites/default/files/styles/medium/public/fcm-ac-business-travellers.png?itok=HWmVrkGg)

## Frequently Asked Questions

- [****What is FCM’s corporate travel management software?****](https://www.fcmtravel.com/en-in#)


FCM's travel management software, FCM Platform, is a globally consistent platform that gives you a single place to manage your entire corporate travel programme. With one platform, you can book and manage travel with powerful analytics for reporting on travel spend, sustainability, and traveller wellbeing. Our open-platform solution allows you to integrate your preferred tools, offering flexibility and control.

- [****How is FCM different from other business travel management companies?****](https://www.fcmtravel.com/en-in#)


FCM stands apart through our flexible approach and global-local service model. Unlike other travel management companies that offer a one-size-fits-all solution, we tailor our services and technology to your specific needs. Our agile structure means you get the consistency of a global network combined with the personalised attention of local expert small teams, ensuring you're supported wherever your business takes you. Our detailed reporting and predictive analytics are unrivalled, back by expert insights. Your negotiated rates and supplier preferences come first in search results.

- [****Can I integrate FCM with our existing expense management system?****](https://www.fcmtravel.com/en-in#)


Yes, you can. FCM Platform is designed for seamless integration with your existing expense management systems, travel risk management providers, and other third-party tools. This ensures a smooth flow of data and a unified process for your travellers and finance teams, saving time and reducing manual effort.

- [****What kind of support can I get with FCM?****](https://www.fcmtravel.com/en-in#)


FCM provides comprehensive support for you and your travellers. This includes dedicated account management to help you strategise and optimise your programme, expert travel consultants for booking and assistance, and 24/7 proactive risk management to support travellers during disruptions. Whether it's through our platform or our people, help is always available.

- [****How does FCM streamline travel approvals and authorisations?****](https://www.fcmtravel.com/en-in#)


FCM simplifies travel approvals through customisable workflows built directly into our platform. You can set up multi-tiered approval paths that align with your company’s travel policy. Automated notifications are sent to designated approvers, who can review and authorise trips quickly via the platform or mobile app, ensuring policy compliance, while speeding up the corporate booking process. These workflows are the same, even if the approver and traveller are based in different countries, using different online booking tools.

- [****What are the benefits of FCM’s digital travel platform?****](https://www.fcmtravel.com/en-in#)


The primary benefits of FCM Platform are efficiency, visibility, and control.



  - It saves you time by reducing complexity, automating processes, and providing AI-powered insights. Managers, travel bookers and travellers each have unique features designed for them, with just one login to remember.
  - You gain complete visibility over your travel programme with real-time data and analytics, driving better decisions. Simulate 'what's next' with predictive reporting. Cutting-edge data capture covers both bookings and missed opportunities.
  - Maintain control by embedding your travel policy into the platform and our agentic AI Sam, empowering travellers to make smart choices while ensuring compliance.

- [**Is FCM suitable for SMEs and large enterprises?**](https://www.fcmtravel.com/en-in#)


FCM specialises in large enterprises and multi-national travel programmes where organisations spend AU$1 million or more on business travel every year. Our solutions are scaled to match your travel volume, budget and specific goals, ensuring a tailored, cost-effective travel management solution that grows with your business. For smaller-volume travel programmes, we have specialist solutions that enable organisations to still benefit from our travel expertise, technology, and strategic mindset.
